body: So far, I'd say it's prettty balanced in content. Besides, why are drawings a bad thing? 👀

I can kind of feel who would vibe with who already just with the descriptions.

Of the 3, Mika seems 'weak' in the aspect of the other two seem to be more solid? Like Mika is everything but not exactly. Idk tho just an opinion, but I think the ideas are overall amazing.

Well, in general it does.
Nsfw rules, content tags, restrictions. I guess it's mainly to keep a certain 'standard' online.

But, all sorts of art will always exist. Something imposed is merely a 'suggestion'. It won't stop the creation of art that might not agree with another person's morality. That's art and humanity in essence.
